column1: # Precedent transactions (US retail). Amounts in millions of `currency`; multiples are EV / LTM metric;
# premium_pct in percent. Empty = not found in a primary source. Do not use the hash character in notes.

column14: EV ~24.6bn incl. ~4.7bn net debt and premium 32.8% to the unaffected close of 2022-10-12: joint press release, Albertsons 8-K Ex.99.1 (2022-10-14). EV/LTM EBITDA 5.4x: Morgan Stanley selected precedent transactions table (AV / LTM EBITDA), fairness opinion section of the Walgreens Boots Alliance DEFM14A (2025-06-06), https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1618921/000119312525137049/d942554ddefm14a.htm. LTM revenue and EBITDA are not stated in Albertsons' DEFM14C (2023-04-21); its advisors used forward estimates. TERMINATED: Albertsons terminated the merger agreement on 2024-12-10 (8-K Item 1.02), so this is an agreed, never paid price.

EV ~13.7bn incl. net debt: Whole Foods 8-K Ex.99.1 press release (2017-06-16). LTM Adjusted EBITDA 1,293m (quarter ended 2017-04-09) and premium 18.5% to the 2017-06-14 close of 35.45: Evercore precedent transactions and implied premium tables, opinion of financial advisor section, Whole Foods DEFM14A (2017-07-21, this URL). EV/EBITDA = 13,700 / 1,293 = 10.6x, the same 10.6x as in Centerview's tables (Smart & Final SC 14D-9 2019; Walgreens DEFM14A 2025). Completed 2017-08-28 (8-K Item 2.01). Strategic buyer with synergies; premium natural/organic grocer.

Value ~1.12bn: announcement communication, SC14D9C Ex.99 (2019-04-16). LTM Adjusted EBITDA 171m (period ended 2019-03-31): Centerview selected transactions analysis, opinion section of the Smart & Final SC 14D-9 (2019-05-14, this URL). EV/EBITDA = 1,120 / 171 = 6.5x, same as Centerview and Morgan Stanley in the Walgreens DEFM14A (2025). Premium ~25% to the average close of the 24 trading days after the 2019-03-13 earnings release (SC 14D-9, reasons section), not to a single unaffected close. Completed 2019-06-20 (8-K). Warehouse-style grocery stores.

Value ~1.36bn and premium ~24% to the 2016-03-11 close: press release, Fresh Market 8-K Ex.99.1 (2016-03-14); the release does not say whether 1.36bn is equity or enterprise value (Morgan Stanley's table in the Walgreens DEFM14A 2025 shows AV ~1.4bn). EV/LTM EBITDA 7.1x: Evercore precedent transactions table, Whole Foods DEFM14A (2017, this URL); also 7.1x in Centerview and Morgan Stanley tables (Walgreens DEFM14A 2025) and 7.3x in Centerview's table (Smart & Final SC 14D-9 2019). LTM EBITDA not stated in Fresh Market's own SC 14D-9 (J.P. Morgan used 2015P / 2016E). Completed 2016-04-27 (8-K).

column3: Nordstrom family and El Puerto de Liverpool
column14: EV ~6.25bn on an enterprise basis and premium ~42% to the unaffected close of 2024-03-18: press release, Nordstrom 8-K Ex.99.1 (2024-12-23). EV/LTM EBITDA 5.7x: Centerview and Morgan Stanley selected precedent transactions tables, Walgreens DEFM14A (2025-06-06, this URL). Nordstrom's own DEFM14A (2025-04-10) gives no LTM EBITDA (J.P. Morgan used FY2025E). Buyer group = founding family plus a Mexican department store operator, not a private equity fund. Completed 2025-05-20 (8-K Item 2.01).

SECOND TIER (business mix: large business-to-business delivery operation). Press release (Staples 8-K Ex.99.1, 2017-06-28): equity value ~6.9bn, premium ~20% to the 10-day VWAP ended 2017-04-03. AV ~6.6bn and AV/LTM EBITDA 5.0x: Morgan Stanley table, Walgreens DEFM14A (2025, this URL); Centerview 5.0x in the same document. Goldman Sachs (At Home SC 14D-9, 2021-06-22) shows TEV 7,947m and 6.0x: the advisors define EV differently. Staples' own DEFM14A uses forward (2017E) EBITDA, no LTM. Completed 2017-09-12 (8-K).

SECOND TIER (home decor superstores). Price raised from 36.00 to 37.00 per share in June 2021. EV 2,830m and EV/LTM EBITDA 7.9x: Jefferies selected transactions table, Franchise Group DEFM14A (2023-07-14, this URL); press releases (At Home 8-K Ex.99.1, 2021-05-06 and 2021-06-15) give ~2.8bn incl. debt. Premium 20.6% to the 2021-05-04 close for the 37.00 offer: At Home SC 14D-9 (2021-06-22), reasons for the recommendation. The SC 14D-9 does not state LTM EBITDA (Goldman used FY2021 Adjusted EBITDA from the forecasts). Completed 2021-07-23 (8-K).
